name: minilogue xd
popularity: Korg's 4-voice analog poly with digital multi-engine; widely reviewed (Sound On Sound review: https://www.soundonsound.com/reviews/korg-minilogue-xd). No sales-chart figure checked.

bendRangeSemitones.how: Per program: PROGRAM EDIT > Button 4 (JOYSTICK) > X+ Bend Range and X- Bend Range, Off or 1-12 notes each. Also NRPN LSB 0x20 (+) / 0x21 (-) via CC99/98 then CC6. Factory default value not stated in the documents.

controls.label: TYPE
controls.notes: Meaning depends on MULTI TYPE. VPM and USER: 16 equal ranges of 8 (0-7, 8-15 ... 120-127) = SIN1,SIN2,SIN3,SIN4,SAW1,SAW2,SQU1,SQU2,FAT1,FAT2,AIR1,AIR2,DECAY1,DECAY2,CREEP,THROAT (VPM) or USER1-16. NOISE: HIGH, LOW, PEAK, DECIM; receive table ranges are garbled in the Korg doc, transmit values are 0,42,84,127 - send those exact values.

controls.label: MOD FX TYPE
controls.notes: Korg doc lists 77~102 and 102~127 (overlap at 102); treated 102 as USER. No dedicated panel knob; chosen with the SELECT position.

controls.label: MOD FX SUB TYPE
controls.notes: Depends on MOD FX TYPE. CHORUS/PHASER/FLANGER: 8 ranges of 16 (0-15...112-127). CHORUS = STEREO, LIGHT, DEEP, TRIPHASE, HARMONIC, MONO, FEEDBACK, VIBRATO. PHASER = STEREO, FAST, ORANGE, SMALL, SMALL RESO, BLACK, FORMANT, TWINKLE. FLANGER = STEREO, LIGHT, MONO, HIGH SWEEP, MID SWEEP, PAN SWEEP, MONO SWEEP, TRIPHASE. ENSEMBLE: 0-42 STEREO, 43-85 LIGHT, 86-127 MONO. USER: 16 ranges of 8.

setup: Press EDIT MODE, turn PROGRAM/VALUE to GLOBAL EDIT (or press EDIT MODE again)
Press button 7 (GLOBAL 5): set MIDI Rx CC = On, MIDI Rx Prog Chg = On, MIDI Rx Pitch Bend = On
Press button 6 (GLOBAL 4): set MIDI Ch to match the app; set MIDI Route = USB+MIDI (or USB if only using USB)
Factory defaults of MIDI Rx CC and MIDI Ch are not stated in the Korg documents, so check them once

setup: MIDI channel: hold MEMORY while turning the power on, then press keyboard button 1-16 for channel 1-16
CC receive: hold FUNC while turning the power on, press keyboard button 7 (MIDI RX ShortMessage) so its LED is lit (On; factory default is On), then press REC to save
Optional: on the same FUNC power-on screen, button 6 = MIDI Clock Src (Auto is default)

setup: Hold ARPEGGIO [ON/OFF] and press button [2] (MIDI Channel), turn [VALUE] to the channel (factory default 1), press ARPEGGIO [ON/OFF] to confirm
No CC-receive on/off setting exists in the owner's manual; CC receive is always on (the only CC setting, [11] Control Change Output Mode, is for transmit)
Do not start the unit in Control Surface Mode: in that mode it makes no sound and recognizes no CC
